title: Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) - Digital Database and Corresponding Interfaces for ReUse of Architectural Components (v0.6.4.1)
description:
The Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) is a prototypical digital component database. It catalogs digital representations of uniquely identifiable architectural components for reuse. Furthermore, it provides corresponding interfaces and tools to leverage them via a backend REST-API, a web-frontend as well as a interface for direct interaction within Rhino Grasshopper.

Changes in v0.6.4.1 (2026-10-27)

Hardening: the MCP connector, the component page and dependencies.

Added

  • Search by evidence method: the catalog list takes evidence_method=<method> (one name of the evidence vocabulary, an unknown name is a 422) and keeps only pieces with at least one published, current record of that method, for example reinforcement_layout for the pieces with a reinforcement layout. It combines with every other filter, also with fit and near. The MCP tools search_components, catalog_overview and similar_components take it as has_evidence. A filter in Browse follows later.
  • A reinforcement layout in the viewer: the card of a reinforcement layout in the evidence list has "Show in viewer", for every status, so a submitted draft can be seen before it is published. The viewer opens the version the bars belong to and draws that layout on top of the published ones, which turn faint; the legend names it with its status, and an x takes it out again. The link can be sent on: whoever may not see the record gets a short note and no bars.

Changed

  • MCP connector: the server introduces itself as the Catalog of Second Chances, with a link to the website and an icon, and its instructions tell a chat to use these tools for reused building components before a web search (in English and German). Every tool has a title and is marked read-only, and the descriptions name the evidence methods.
  • MCP, reinforcement: get_component and get_version count the reinforcement layouts of the version from its evidence records (records, bars, diameters) instead of the old inline field, which always gave 0. In get_evidence a layout record carries a summary of its bars, and performed_by shows the organization.
  • Similar pieces: on a wide screen the card sits in the left rail below Provenance, with smaller tiles, three to a row, so it no longer pushes the evidence records down. On a narrow screen it keeps its place after Photos and location. "Show more" appears only when there are more than six similar pieces.
  • Statistics: the size facet of /identities/stats (bbxX) buckets the largest side of each piece in millimetres (0, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000 and more); the old edges came from the metre era and put nearly every piece in the last bucket. Pieces without a size are left out instead of counting as the largest.
  • Write model: creating or changing a version rejects the old inline field geometry.reinforcements; a reinforcement layout is an evidence record.

Security

  • E-mail verification accepts only the hashed token. The fallback to a token stored in plain text is gone (such tokens expired a day after 0.6.1.1); an account that is still unverified can ask for a new mail.
  • Dependencies: the frontend lockfile takes undici 7.30.1 and fast-uri 3.1.9 (one high, two medium and two low advisories; both come only through the development tool shadcn, the production install was not affected). The local import scripts move to Pillow 13.0.0.

Server notes

  • No step needed: no new setting, collection or index.
  • In claude.ai the connector can be renamed to "Catalog of Second Chances" (Settings, Connectors); the name the server gives itself is shown when it is added again.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md
